name: blender
description: Drive a live Blender 5.1+ session through the official Blender Lab MCP server: inspect blend files and objects, run bpy code, search the bundled Python API and manual, capture viewport screenshots, and verify every change. The client starts the server itself over stdio; the artist only opens Blender with the Lab MCP add-on enabled.

interface.tagline: Build and animate 3D scenes in a live Blender session.
prompts: Build a small treasure-room scene in Blender and animate the chest lid opening over 30 frames.

BLENDER_MCP_PORT.label: Blender port
BLENDER_MCP_PORT.description: The port of the MCP add-on inside Blender (Preferences > Add-ons > MCP). It is 9876 unless you changed it.
